# fjordrun_team_billing (Data Source)

A team's plan, spending limit and auto-recharge settings. Balances change with usage, so don't derive configuration from them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_team_billing" "acme" {
  team_id = var.team_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Read-Only

- `auto_recharge` (Attributes) Auto-recharge settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_recharge))
- `credit_balance_eur` (Number) Credit balance.
- `current_period_end` (String) End of the billing period.
- `has_payment_method` (Boolean) Whether a payment method is saved.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `pay_as_you_go` (Boolean) Whether usage beyond credit is invoiced.
- `plan` (String) Plan.
- `status` (String) Billing status.
- `usage_limit_eur` (Number) Spending limit, if any.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_recharge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_recharge`

Read-Only:

- `amount_eur` (Number) Amount.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is on.
- `month_spent_eur` (Number) Charged this month.
- `monthly_cap_eur` (Number) Monthly cap.
- `threshold_eur` (Number) Threshold.
